title: Apply execution-free task-folder deletions with retained history and required-child barriers
outcome: Apply execution-free task-folder deletions with retained history and required-child barriers
acceptance: On an enrolled destination, eligible Open task-sync-restored members omitted from the selected complete folder are materialized through one ordinary local Cancelled Disposed event per task, run-free and children-before-parents, in the same transaction as S2.2 adds and scalar edits. No run, root execution, claim, contributor, grant, waiver or native completion is created or changed by removal. Original task rows, parent/root/relations, origins/restored records, notes/activity, older events/results/seals are retained. New complete membership excludes removals; already-retired rows remain excluded across re-export/restart/repair; retained Cancelled documents remain members. Enrolled delete-all followed by new add uses full enrolled admission, never legacy bootstrap; retired ids remain reserved.

Adds/edits/deletes share preflight, atomic commit, existing bounded task-id-ordered refusal and exact replay/dry-run semantics. Select one conflict per task under documented per-task-before-graph precedence; preserve omitted-conflict counts. Deletion names target run/history/lifecycle/origin or blocking ancestor/root and surviving local/shared referrer as applicable. Graph-invalid R retains existing early invalid_graph precedence. Full prospective export includes omitted local nonmembers; immutable historical-origin union includes retired rows. One refusal writes no selected change, baseline or receipt, and changes no runtime authority. Unchanged terminal/native neighbors gain no event.

Removing a required child preserves the parent's durable required-child barrier and parent row. Ordinary otherwise-admitted parent's done refuses until a project-bound session records the ordinary explicit attributed waiver; a valid done can then proceed under all unchanged conditions. Import creates no implicit waiver, child seal or acceptance credit. Optional disposed children keep their ordinary handling too.

Fail-first tests prove the event/read/replay/no-runtime path and deletion/add integration, hidden-local references, historical retirement waves, delete-all routing, held/prior-run/seal/terminal refusals, barrier preservation, complete rollback, dry-run/replay and notice preservation. verify_all remains healthy. Repair touches only declared disposable projections; compare ALL durable rows/old results and object bytes. Any need for new kind/operation/transition/DDL/conversion or altered old-row/completion meaning stops that seam for an explicit decision.

completion.summary: Landed run-free task-folder removals with retained history, shared atomic admission, required-child barriers and deterministic regression coverage. Full gate passed all 12 stages and 3,737 tests; independent acceptance passed all four criteria; all six live stores ready before and after commit. Installed the clean committed release without stopping running processes.
